message: It's my first week lifting at a full gym. Make me a lower-body workout using only machines, with 3 exercises, 2 sets of 12 reps each, and 60 seconds of rest between sets.
I'm an intermediate lifter at a full gym. Build a lower-body strength session around Leg Press. Include Leg Press and use 3 exercises total, each for 3 sets of 6–8 reps. No barbell work today.

I have one kettlebell and a clear patch of floor. Draft a short lower-body workout for an intermediate lifter. Use only the kettlebell, include Goblet Squat, and give me 2 exercises for 3 sets of 8 reps each.

I'm new to lifting and have two dumbbells, a flat bench, and nothing else. Can you draft an upper-body workout with both a push and a pull? Give me 3 exercises using the dumbbells, 2 sets of 8–10 reps each.

The free-weight area is closed at my full gym, but the cable station is open. I'm intermediate. Draft an upper-body workout using only cables and cover a push and a pull. Give me 4 exercises, 3 sets of 10 reps each, with 90 seconds of rest.

I'm a beginner learning the main movement patterns at a full gym. Build one whole-body session with 4 exercises, 2 sets of 8 reps each, and a 4-minute warm-up. The entire visit needs to fit within 25 minutes.

I train at an intermediate level. For today's whole-body strength workout I've got two dumbbells but no bench. Use only dumbbells for the 4 exercises. Keep it to 2 sets of 12 reps each and fit the session within 22 minutes.

Draft a beginner whole-body strength workout I can do at home while my downstairs neighbor sleeps. Bodyweight only and no jumping. I'd like 3 exercises for 2 sets each, with 30 seconds of work and 45 seconds off per set.

I'm intermediate and have a full gym. Draft one upper-body lifting session for today. Keep overhead movements out, include both pressing and rowing, and prescribe 4 exercises for 3 sets of 6–8 reps with 120 seconds of rest.
I'm intermediate and train at a full gym. Draft a weekly routine for upper body on Monday, lower body on Thursday, and whole body on Saturday. Give me 3 exercises per session, 3 sets of 8 reps each.

My shifts change every week. Put together a beginner whole-body routine for 3 sessions per week, on whatever days I can get them done. I only have two dumbbells and a clear floor. Use only dumbbells, with 3 exercises per session and 2 sets of 10 reps each.

I'm a beginner with a full gym. Build me a weekly routine for Monday, Wednesday, and Friday with the same whole-body workout on all three days. Keep each session within 18 minutes and give me 3 exercises for 2 sets of 8 reps each.

Draft an intermediate upper-body routine for 4 sessions per week at a full gym. I want to choose the days myself and vary the exercise selection between sessions. Give me 3 exercises per session and 2 sets of 10–12 reps each.

Draft a 3-session weekly whole-body routine for a beginner at a full gym. The only days I can train are Wednesday and Sunday, and I can do at most one session on each day. Give me 3 exercises per session.
Build me an intermediate upper-body workout for my full gym. Give me exactly 3 exercises total and exactly 5 exercises total. Both counts refer to today's single workout.

Can you draft an intermediate whole-body strength workout for a full gym? I need 4 exercises and 3 sets of 8 reps each with 2 minutes of rest between sets, but the entire workout must fit within 10 minutes. I can't change the rest, volume, or time cap.
